what: A small ball falls from above and bounces on the floor (the element’s bottom edge), with each bounce its height shrinks by the bounciness factor until it settles on the ground. One up-and-down takes √(height/initial height) × dur, and for 14% just before and after contact it squashes wide and flat (squash × √(height/initial height)). It appears during the fade after the delay, and given multiple colors it blinks, changing every blink seconds — used on the loader ball, the dot in the wordmark and the period at the end of a title.

options.drop: Height where the fall begins (px), default 240
options.from: If floor, it does not fall but bounces up by height from the floor
options.height: Bounce height (px) when from: floor, default 160
options.dur: Time (s) for the initial height to rise and fall once, default .7
options.bounciness: Fraction of height kept on each bounce (0~1), default .6 — above .985 it no longer decays and keeps the same height
options.gap: Time resting on the floor between non-decaying bounces (seconds), default .06
options.rest: Rest time after the bounce (seconds) — with loop, rests then repeats, default .8
options.opacity: Start opacity, default 1 (if 0, it appears during the fade)
options.loop: If false, bounces once and settles on the floor, default true
options.colors: Comma-separated colors (variables like var(--kf-accent)) — two or more make it blink
